faq.q: How do I choose a district?
faq.a: Decide what the purchase is for: living all year round, holidays or renting out. For living, look at infrastructure and schools (Oba, Cikcilli); for renting out, closeness to the beach and the centre. An expert will compare 2–3 districts for your needs.

faq.q: Can I view a property by video?
faq.a: Yes. We run live video viewings: the apartment, the view from the windows, the complex and the way to the sea. You can ask any questions.

faq.q: What costs are there on top of the price?
faq.a: TAPU registration tax, fees, translation and notary, DASK insurance and utility connections. We give a full estimate before booking.

faq.q: How are the agency's services paid for?
faq.a: Property search, viewings (in person and by video) and consultations are free. For resale properties the agency fee is 2% of the price + VAT (KDV); for our partners' new builds the developer pays it. For long-term rentals it is one month's rent. The terms are fixed in a contract before the first viewing.

trustq.q: Why do prices differ between websites?
trustq.a: The same property is often sold by several agencies. Prices differ because of the floor, view, furniture, commission and outdated listings. We compare the same unit: floor, area, view and terms of the deal.

trustq.q: How to spot a bait listing?
trustq.a: A price that is too low, no ID or complex address, "already sold, but there's a similar one". We show the date the price was checked and confirm availability before booking.
Send us the link on WhatsApp or via the form below — we'll check whether it is the same unit and what is included in the price.
